Workflow

How VoxBridge Translates Media

From upload to download, see the exact steps our backend takes to orchestrate state-of-the-art AI networks.

01

Upload Media

Drag & drop your audio or video file (MP4, MP3, WAV, etc.) to the dashboard secure upload module.

02

Speech Recognition

Our Whisper engine automatically transcribes the audio, generating timestamps and speaker identities.

03

Translate Text

AI translations localize transcripts into 40+ target languages while retaining expressions and idiomatic phrasing.

04

Voice Cloning

Neural voice APIs generate translations using a clone of the speaker's original voice tone and emotion.

05

Lip Sync (Video)

For video submissions, visual neural models synthesize lip movements to seamlessly match the newly translated output.

06

Render & Download

Export localized MP4, MP3, or grab transcript files (TXT, SRT, VTT) directly from the project history board.
